title: The Plague
author: Albert Camus
summary: When rats begin dying in the Algerian port city of Oran, an epidemic follows and the town is sealed off. The story follows a doctor and the people around him as they decide how to live while it rages.
readIf: you want a thoughtful, calm novel about duty, solidarity and living with a crisis.
skipIf: you want a thriller about the disease; this is a philosophical novel with little suspense.

pairings.reason: Camus's shorter, colder novel about indifference and meaning.
A more hopeful pandemic novel about what people hold on to when the world ends.
A far bleaker book about a father and son surviving after a collapse.
